ED_Title: Strengthening of the coordination of emergency humanitarian assistance of the United Nations
ED_DecisionText: At its 78th plenary meeting, on 15 April 2026, the General Assembly, on the proposal of Sweden (Footnote: A/80/L.47.),  reaffirming its resolution 46/182 of 19 December 1991 and the guiding principles contained in the annex thereto, and other relevant General Assembly and Economic and Social Council resolutions, including Assembly resolution 79/140 of 9 December 2024, requested the Secretary-General to report to the General Assembly at its eighty-first session, through the Economic and Social Council at its 2026 session, on progress made in strengthening the coordination of emergency humanitarian assistance of the United Nations, and to submit a report to the Assembly on the detailed use of the Central Emergency Response Fund.
